title: Joe Brady: We know we’re going to get the best version of Lamar Jackson

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Joe Brady: We know we’re going to get the best version of Lamar Jackson
sources.description: While it feels like nothing will be truly official until the first snap on Sunday, Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson is now set to start against the Bills after missing Baltimore's last three games with a high ankle sprain.
